about: Source manifest for the directory guides. Each entry points to a Markdown body in directory/editorial/. scripts/build-directory.mjs renders every entry whose status is "published" to its path: the H1, byline, Reviewed date, JSON-LD and CTA modules come from this manifest, not the Markdown. The renderer drops the Markdown H1 and the two paragraphs after it (the byline and the Reviewed line, kept so the file reads correctly on GitHub). Under "## FAQ", each "###" heading is a question and the paragraphs until the next heading are its answer; the FAQ stays visible, and no FAQPage markup is emitted because Google limits FAQ rich results and the rest of the site does not use it consistently. "## Quotable facts" renders as a list with id="facts". link_from names the pages that link to each guide; the build fails on an entry it cannot place. Internal links in a body must resolve to a generated page, or the build fails. cta.footer names a variant in directory/services-cta.json campaigns as "<campaign>:<variant>". scripts/build-awesome-directory.mjs links published guides to the site and drafts to their Markdown source.
